description: SPEC §16 R2 step 4, §6.7 step 4: an overwhelming win deals exactly the round's cap. Your army (40 damage supply, the Rootbreakers' counted twice) wipes the general's Tenders, which never attack, so all of it survives: 100 × 40 = 4000 before the cap, and the general's Heartcap takes exactly the round's cap, a fixed 750 (#68). Merging is off.
